title: FASHION-RQ: Mining Hierarchical Semantic Structure for Automated Evaluation of Fashion Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.17841v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Evaluating fashion retrieval systems remains challenging due to the limited availability of benchmarks that capture the fine-grained, open-ended queries encountered in real-world search and recommendation. Existing benchmarks often rely on manual curation, predefined taxonomies, or synthetic prompts, limiting scalability and semantic coverage. We introduce FASHION-RQ: Mining Hierarchical Semantic Structure for Automated Evaluation of Fashion Retrieval, an automated framework that derives user-type queries and relevance sets directly from catalog structure. Our key insight is that hierarchical discrete representations learned by Residual Quantized Variational Autoencoders (RQ-VAE) organize products into semantically coherent clusters at progressively finer granularities. translated_title: FASHION-RQ：挖掘层次化语义结构用于时尚检索的自动化评估
translated_abstract: 时尚检索系统的评估仍然具有挑战性，原因在于缺乏能够捕捉真实世界搜索与推荐中所遇到的细粒度、开放式查询的基准数据集。现有基准通常依赖人工整理、预定义的分类体系或合成提示，这限制了可扩展性和语义覆盖范围。我们提出FASHION-RQ：一个从商品目录结构中直接推导用户类型查询和相关性集合的自动化评估框架。我们的核心洞察在于，由残差量化变分自编码器（RQ-VAE）学习到的层次化离散表示，能够将商品组织成在逐渐精细的粒度上语义连贯的簇。我们利用这一结构构建了FASHION-RQBENCH，一个无需人工查询标注或预定义分类体系的可扩展基准。我们提出了四个互补的任务……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出FASHION-RQ框架，利用RQ-VAE学习到的层次化离散语义结构，自动从商品目录中生成用户查询与相关性集合，从而构建了无需人工标注和预定义分类体系的可扩展时尚检索评估基准FASHION-RQBENCH。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FASHION-RQ, an automated framework that mines hierarchical semantic structure from RQ-VAE discrete representations of product catalogs to generate user queries and relevance sets, enabling FASHION-RQBENCH—a scalable fashion retrieval benchmark requiring no manual annotation or predefined taxonomies.
